purpose: Each verified customer signs up and tests an isolated workspace with persisted sample data. Financial reports are read-only; sensitive actions are unavailable.

api.client: Use the existing Supabase browser client with the branch-scoped public URL and publishable key.
api.authority: Real Auth session plus database workspace ownership. Never trust a role or workspace ID from user_metadata, a role selector, query parameters or localStorage.
api.public_demo_auth: Verified email and password session (AAL1 allowed). Do not weaken native MFA requirements or give native/platform roles to demo users.
api.consent: Privacy acceptance required; marketing consent optional and separate; phone is contact-only, not SMS verified.
signup_sequence: Collect registration fields, privacy acceptance and optional marketing consent.
Use real Supabase Auth signUp. Non-authoritative contact fields may be carried as signup metadata, never permissions.
If Auth returns no session, show email confirmation pending and resume after the verified callback.
Call demo_get_my_workspace_v1. If null, validate signup fields through demo_initialize_workspace_v1; otherwise load the existing workspace.
Route to the authenticated demo workspace, fetch items and reports, and keep caches scoped by Auth UID plus workspace ID.
Only explicit profile/consent edits should call initialization again for an existing workspace. Reloads must not repeatedly overwrite consent.

demo_get_my_workspace_v1.returns: null or workspace descriptor with id, name, locale, is_demo, role, navigation, features and own profile

arguments.p_mobile: 8..15 digits, optional leading plus; spaces/parentheses/hyphens normalized

demo_initialize_workspace_v1.semantics: One workspace per real Auth user; initialization is atomic and repeat-safe; existing workspaces are not reseeded.

demo_list_items_v1.returns: workspace_id, is_demo, items, total, limit, offset

arguments.p_idempotency_key: stable request UUID, reuse on network retry

demo_create_item_v1.limits: 500 items per workspace; retries with the same key and request create no duplicate

demo_update_item_v1.conflict: HTTP409 / PT409: refresh the record and show a localized conflict message; do not retry blindly.

demo_get_reports_v1.returns: workspace_id, is_demo, generated_at, counts, maintenance, finance, activity, source, native_business_data
demo_get_reports_v1.financial_truth: Use these SQL-derived sample totals and periods. Do not invent bank balances or real ledger results from them.

seed.visibility: Show a clear sample-data demo label; no real dispatch, payment or document upload.

frontend_acceptance: Signup, verification callback, login and automatic own-workspace provisioning on the actual preview.
No manual administrator, shared pilot workspace or native membership is required for public signup.
All relevant site menus remain visible according to the actual demo role and server feature flags; finance is read-only and sensitive actions visibly unavailable.
Replace static/mock DemoStore report data with these RPC reads. Save nonfinancial interactions through RPC, then refetch reports; handle failure without fake success.
After refresh or logout/login, persisted edits remain; switching accounts clears old workspace state and never leaks another user's data.
No native Operations/financial endpoints, service secrets, privileged role grants or guard removal.
RO/EN/FA desktop/mobile browser evidence for two separate customer sessions, including at least one edit changing a report.
Typecheck, relevant lint/build and browser checks on the submitted commit. Never claim email delivery or browser acceptance from backend-only tests.

verification.cleanup_command: Same environment and command with argument cleanup; never commit the private session file
